content:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store. I have completed butcher training and have worked in butchery and meat-counter roles since 2015, with hands-on experience preparing fresh meat and serving customers.

In my current role, I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat for the counter, and advise customers on cuts and cooking times. I also rotate cold-room stock using FIFO and record HACCP temperature checks for the cold room and display counter twice daily. My earlier experience at the Dolac market stall included weighing and pricing orders, operating the till, and cleaning and sanitising equipment and the counter.

FreshCart’s focus on fresh local food, knowledgeable service and high hygiene standards appeals to me. I would bring practical butchery experience, reliability and a friendly approach to helping customers. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is clear, concise, professional, and appropriately tailored to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It explains the candidate’s butcher training, relevant experience, customer service, FIFO stock rotation, and HACCP recordkeeping without making unsupported claims. The progression from current butchery work to earlier counter-assistant duties is easy to follow. Its main limitation is that it remains somewhat general: it does not use the strongest available evidence of scale and impact, such as carcass volumes, customer numbers, or fresh sausage production.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter is ATS-friendly because it uses simple formatting, standard headings are not required for a short letter, and relevant terms such as butcher training, fresh meat, FIFO, HACCP, cuts, cooking times, till, and sanitising are present. It directly names the target position and employer. AI screening probability is high because the document clearly connects the candidate’s experience to the role’s core duties and must-have requirements. ATS alignment could be strengthened by using the job description’s exact wording, particularly “HACCP knowledge,” “service counter,” “cut and portion fresh meat,” and “temperature and hygiene checks.” Do not add self-service packaging, tray-sealer, supermarket, or forklift experience because the candidate’s materials do not support those claims.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The candidate strongly matches the two must-have requirements: completed butcher training and substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, plus documented HACCP practice. The letter aligns well with FreshCart’s priorities of fresh food, knowledgeable customer advice, hygiene, reliability, and friendly service. It also demonstrates relevant duties including cutting, boning, trimming, portioning, customer advice, FIFO rotation, temperature checks, till operation, and equipment sanitation. The candidate lacks the nice-to-have forklift licence, but this is not a defect in the letter and should not be presented as one. The letter could better distinguish the candidate by highlighting the available evidence of production volume and customer-facing workload.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT 1 — In the second paragraph, strengthen the evidence of practical experience by replacing the opening sentence with: “In my current role, I break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter, and produce up to approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per week during the busy season.” This uses truthful, measurable evidence from the candidate’s materials and more closely matches the job’s wording.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 2 — In the same paragraph, replace “I also rotate cold-room stock using FIFO and record HACCP temperature checks for the cold room and display counter twice daily” with: “I also rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO and complete temperature and hygiene checks for the cold room and display counter twice daily, maintaining HACCP records.” This makes the HACCP knowledge and FIFO responsibilities more explicit for ATS and recruiter review.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 3 — Before the closing paragraph, add one sentence showing customer-service scale: “I serve approximately 120 customers on a busy Saturday and advise them on suitable cuts, quantities and cooking times.” This directly reflects the role’s customer-advice requirement while remaining fully supported by the candidate’s information.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 4 — In the final paragraph, change “I would bring practical butchery experience, reliability and a friendly approach to helping customers” to “I would bring practical butchery experience, reliable hygiene routines and a friendly, knowledgeable approach to helping customers.” This better mirrors FreshCart’s stated culture and the role’s emphasis on honest product advice and hygiene.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
requirements.quote: I have completed butcher training and have worked in butchery and meat-counter roles since 2015
I also rotate cold-room stock using FIFO and record HACCP temperature checks for the cold room and display counter twice daily.
